build_Wav2vec_U_model: build a wav2vec unsupervised model with discriminator and generator for audio representation learning
create_Discriminator: create a causal convolutional discriminator network to classify real versus generated audio features
create_Generator: create a convolutional generator network to project audio features into discrete token space
create_Segmenter: create a segmenter to subsample audio features using random or uniform random strategies
create_Wav2vec_UConfig: create a Wav2vec_UConfig dataclass to configure discriminator, generator, and segmentation hyperparameters
